rules.crewFeatNote: Airship Campaigns p. 51. Training a feat takes ten workweeks minus the training officer's CHA modifier, at 5 gp per crew member per workweek. Only the party's own crew trains feats; a ship with trackFeats: false skips the section.

crewFeats.name: Ballista Experts
crewFeats.summary: No long-range disadvantage with ballistae. A ballista needs 2 crew instead of 3. +2 to a ballista attack on a turn the ship did not move.

crewFeats.name: Cannon Experts
crewFeats.summary: No long-range disadvantage with light or heavy cannons. Light cannon needs 2 crew, heavy needs 3. Captain may take -5 to hit for +10 damage on a cannon attack.

crewFeats.name: Combat Experts
crewFeats.summary: When boarding and not incapacitated or surprised, the crew's first turn bonus action is a group attack against a hostile crew.

crewFeats.name: Dedicated
crewFeats.summary: Needs an attuned character with CHA 13+. Charisma checks to avoid crew fatigue are made at advantage.

crewFeats.name: Defensive Manoeuvres
crewFeats.summary: With half crew or more aboard, the ship's components get +2 AC and +2 to DEX saves.

crewFeats.name: Exceptional Teamwork
crewFeats.summary: One d6 Teamwork die per day, added to one attack roll or saving throw by the crew or the ship, decided after the d20 but before the result.

crewFeats.name: Highly Disciplined
crewFeats.summary: The ship and its officers ignore Boost Morale complications.

crewFeats.name: Lookouts
crewFeats.summary: With half crew or more: +5 initiative, crew passive Perception 12, the ship can't be surprised, and unseen attackers get no advantage.

crewFeats.name: Take Cover
crewFeats.summary: Area effects that allow a DEX save for half instead do nothing on a success and half on a failure, while the crew is aboard.

rules.crewQualityNote: crew_quality is 1 to 5, 5 best. The label and the Gunnery modifier come from it. Gunnery is added to every weapon attack on the kit list and nothing else.
rules.conditionNote: condition is 1 to 5, 5 best, set by hand from how the ship has been treated in play. Independent of hull HP.
rules.speedNote: Speed is a 1 to 5 scale, kept in the JSON for reference. Cargo hulls cap at 3. Adding an engine to a Shoal raises it to its cap.
reference: Spelldriving: a Spell Jet Thruster or Spell Cannon needs a spellcaster at it. The rest of the crew minimum can be deckhands.
Crew minimums on the kit list are the book numbers, kept for reference. Who is actually at what is handled on the map.
Engine Class is the book's speed and altitude tier. Class 1 is slow and low, Class 2 is standard.

assignmentNote: A ship note's `assignment` property names one of these by id. Free text still works, it just unlocks nothing. Shops opt in with a `fleetUnlock` property naming an assignment id; `mode: full` lifts a shop's stock limit while the assignment is active.

assignments.label: With the party
assignments.note: The ship goes where the party goes. Only whatever port they are in is open.

assignments.label: Docked
assignments.note: Tied up in port. Crew on shore leave, ship available for repairs and refits.

assignments.label: Goa Zo trade run
assignments.note: Ferrying goods to and from Goa Zo. The Goa Zo storefronts are reachable wherever the crew is.
